{{Quote|There isn't enough life on this ice cube to fill a space cruiser. Sensors are placed, I'm going back.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[File:SensorsArePlaced-TCGtSfS.jpg|thumb|300px|A Rebel places a sensor beacon on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].]]

'''Sensor beacons''' were [[Security scanner/Legends|security scanners]] and alarm systems that were typically deployed around large tracts of land, such as agricultural facilities, [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]], parks, bases and large wilderness areas. When properly placed and calibrated, a network of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] beacons provided complete electronic surveillance of an area. The information gathered by the beacons was fed to a command station or central location which could then trigger an alert to any intrusions on the land.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used sensor beacons to guard their remote bases. The Alliance deployed [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[SE-Vigilant automated sensor beacon]]s around [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="EGWT" />
